description: This C# source file defines classes related to in-memory grain storage with simulated latency in Orleans framework. It includes options configuration and a storage provider implementation that adds fixed latency to storage operations, primarily for testing purposes.

classes.name: MemoryStorageWithLatencyOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the memory storage provider with latency, including default latency, optional mocking of calls, and a latency property.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorageWithLatency
classes.description: An in-memory implementation of Orleans grain storage that simulates fixed latency in storage operations, useful for testing and simulation scenarios.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads the state data asynchronously with added fixed latency.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes the state data asynchronously with added fixed latency.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears the state data asynchronously with added fixed latency.

methods.name: MakeFixedLatencyCall
methods.description: Helper method to enforce fixed latency for storage calls, handling timing and exceptions.
